name: Island Studio Residency 2027
description: Six weeks in a converted boathouse on a small island, for painters and textile artists. Studio, lodging and a materials budget are covered; one open studio day at the end.

name: Riverside Foundation Project Grant
description: Project grants of up to 12,000 for artists based in the region, for a new body of work to be shown within two years. Applications are read by a panel of artists.

name: Open Call: Small Formats
description: A group exhibition of works no larger than 40 cm in any direction. Paintings, drawings and textiles are welcome; no entry fee.

name: Paper Biennial: Works on Paper
description: The biennial selects 40 works on paper for a touring exhibition across three cities. Drawings, prints and collages made in the last three years.

name: Slow Craft Fellowship
description: A one-year fellowship for artists working with traditional techniques in a contemporary way: a monthly stipend, mentoring and a final presentation.

name: Harbour Lights Public Art Commission
description: A temporary light installation for the harbour front during the winter festival. Budget 25,000 including production; shortlisted artists receive a design fee.

name: Winter Studio Exchange
description: Two artists from the region swap studios with two artists from abroad for one month in February. Travel and a weekly allowance are covered.

name: Coastal Residency 2027
description: A two-month residency on the coast for painters and textile artists, with a studio by the sea, lodging and a stipend.
summary: A strong fit: a coastal residency for painters and textile artists, fully funded.
notes: Portfolio set ready: Low Tide + Woven Weather.

details.overview: Two-month residency for painters and textile artists on the coast.
details.offer: Studio, lodging, a monthly stipend of 1,500 and travel.
details.requirements: Portfolio of up to 15 images, a one-page proposal, a CV.
details.focus: Work that responds to landscape and weather.
details.fit: Both Low Tide and Woven Weather respond directly to shore and weather.
details.verdict_reason: Close match to the current work; deadline in January.

name: Textile Art Prize 2027
description: An annual prize for contemporary textile art: 8,000 and a solo presentation at the Textile Museum, Westfield.
summary: Eligible; tapestries fit the prize, a shortlist placing last year helps.

details.requirements: Three works made in the last two years, images and dimensions.
details.fit: Woven Weather is recent and fits well.
details.verdict_reason: Shortlisted last year; the new tapestries are stronger.

name: Mill Pond Residency
description: A residency in a former mill for artists working with water and sound.
summary: Partly relevant: the water theme fits, but the residency asks for a sound component.

details.overview: Residency in a former mill, focus on water and sound.
details.fit: The water theme fits Low Tide; sound is not part of the practice.
details.verdict_reason: Apply only with a collaborator for the sound part.

name: Example Culture Fund: Mobility Grant
description: Travel grants for artists invited to a residency or exhibition abroad.
summary: Eligible once a residency invitation is confirmed.

details.offer: Travel and per diem, up to 2,500.
details.requirements: An invitation letter from the host.
details.fit: Useful together with a residency acceptance.
details.verdict_reason: Prepare now, send when the Coastal Residency answers.

name: Northern Light Video Art Call
description: Screening programme for video works under ten minutes.

details.fit: No video work in the practice.

name: City of Eastmoor Working Grant
description: Working grants for artists living in Eastmoor, for one year of studio work.

details.overview: City working grant for local artists.

name: Paper Mill Residency 2027
description: A month in a working paper mill, making paper and works on paper.

details.overview: Residency in a working paper mill.
details.fit: Paper Maps is a direct match.

name: Weavers' Guild Materials Grant
description: Small grants for yarn, dyes and loom parts.
summary: Applied; the guild interviews shortlisted applicants.

details.fit: Woven Weather uses exactly these materials.

name: Glasshouse Painting Prize
description: An open painting prize with an exhibition of the shortlist.

name: Saltworks Summer Residency 2026
description: A summer residency in an old salt works by the marsh.

name: Autumn Drawing Prize 2026
description: A drawing prize with a small exhibition.
summary: Closed before the drawings were ready.

name: Riverside Studios Open Studios
description: Studio holders and guests open their studios for one weekend in March.
summary: A light commitment; good for showing work in progress.

details.offer: A shared studio for the weekend, publicity.
details.requirements: A short description and two images.
details.fit: Could show the new tapestries on the loom.

name: Orchestra in Residence 2027
description: A residency for composers writing for chamber orchestra.

name: Corporate Lobby Mural Contract
description: Paid mural for a corporate lobby, brand colours required.

name: Paid Portfolio Review Service
description: Pay 90 for a portfolio review and a listing in an online catalogue.

name: Stock Illustration Contest
description: Illustrations for a stock image library; winners receive royalties.
